description: This is a React functional component written in TypeScript, serving as a detailed client-side interface for a course detail page in an LMS application. It manages course modules, videos, quizzes, assignments, resources, instructor info, and AI-powered recommendations, integrating various API calls and state management for an interactive learning experience.

methods.name: ResourceCard
methods.description: A functional component that displays resource links (view in LMS, download) for course materials.

methods.name: markModuleComplete
methods.description: Marks a module as completed, updates progress, unlocks next module, and triggers backend API call.

methods.name: canAccessModule
methods.description: Determines if the user can access a given module based on prior completion.
